title.narrative: Support to the promotion of Civil Society regional actions in the Western Balkans (Phase II)

description.narrative: The overall objective of this action is to strengthen regional cooperation and participatory democracies around the Western Balkans region. The action also intends to strengthen civil society organisations¿ capacity to absorb donors' funds and implement gender responsive regional cooperation projects in line with international best practices and to strengthen and expand platforms for dialogue and cooperation between civil society organisations and other key stakeholders.
